signals.thesis: Captures historic semiconductor rally: INTC +110%, AMD best since 2001, MRVL best since 2001. Near 52W high $463.87. Broader equal-weighted exposure vs SMH. AI capex $1T+ validates structural demand.
Best month since 2001. Custom AI silicon demand from AWS (Trainium) and Google (TPU). 5G infrastructure secondary driver. Above all moving averages with expanding volume.
